title: Prism Breaker 2077
description: Cyberpunk physics block-breaker. Aim precision laser orbs, trigger dynamic synth-wave color combos, and shatter descending prism nodes.
author: AwaisGames Studio

controls.desktop: Drag mouse to aim trajectory beam · Release to fire orbs · Space to fast-forward · P to Pause
controls.mobile: Touch & drag to aim laser guide · Lift finger to launch wave
